mhc_export.assay__comments: A C1R-f1502 stable clone was generated by means of transfection of the full-length cDNA plasmid encoding HLA-B*1502. The endogenous peptides in HLA-B*1502 were removed by using cold mild citric acid. The reconstitution was detected by using anti–HLA class I antibody (w6/32) with flow cytometry.
